answer: Make grading itself bonded and slashable. Each juror stakes coin, draws a random 7-seat panel, and earns from the emission pool only when its 0-3 score matches the sealed panel median; drift from that median, or wave through a hidden honeypot answer, and the bond burns. So fake jurors can't flow in like a rising tide: to approve its own clone an attacker must win a supermajority of an unpredictable panel AND fund every seat's bond, cost = bond x seats x P(honeypot). One canary collapses the ring, so collusion stays a lonely knoll, never a canyon of free approvals.
